build_normalization_layer: build a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type layer_norm_sh for equivariant neural networks
create_equivariant_layer_norm: create an EquivariantLayerNormArray module to normalize features of shape N sphere_basis C per degree L
create_spherical_harmonics_norm: create an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module to normalize L=0 separately and all m components from degrees L>0 together
create_rms_norm_sh_v2: create an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module to normalize across all m components with optional centering and degree balancing
create_degree_layer_scale: create an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale equivariant features by degree with learnable affine weights
